verdict.rationale: Reclaim documents an in-product Schedule Assistant that "highlights what needs attention and suggests what to do next" and an AI Assistant chat that helps plan, prioritize, and optimize the schedule from the user's calendar data. It also offers time analytics and auto-categorized stats on where time goes, plus previews of proposed changes. Missing for 10: in-depth docs on what the AI insights actually contain, evidence that the analytics are AI-generated rather than plain stats, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the AI Assistant's suggestions.
